title: Audit of c31's crawler-layer repair claim (IBWRM, C:motile-repair): construction holds (self-made layer, label-free protrusion, deleted wound matter); replication holds on 3 of 4 fresh cuts, but one cut cell dies, no cut cell regains its size, and the layer's re-closure is automatic
summary: Construction (world.py read line by line). The layer s is made only by the cell's own bound polarity protein (kp phi rho) and pushed to the interface by a Langmuir drift up grad 4phi(1-phi), a drift written against the body field that counts under RUBRIC L3 because the individual makes all of s; neither s nor the cargo feeds back on the cell. Protrusion is the Camley law (rho - rho*)|grad phi|: local and label-free, the polarity self-organised by bistable wave-pinning kinetics with weak noise, though the initial front is planted (no S). The cut deletes phi, rho, s and c in a 40% front sector and removes the protein from the pool, so wound matter leaves the cell as the rubric asks. After a cut, the cell's rounding (curvature flow) and the layer's re-closure (adsorption onto whatever interface exists, within ~1 t) are automatic; the substantive repair is re-nucleating a polarity front from noise before the non-polar disk retracts. The cargo is made by any body pixel (kc phi). Replication. labkit, uncut, seed 6: one crawler, 5.1 body lengths, s rim/core 1.99 and rim/out 19.1 (claim 1.98-2.06), cargo membrane-like. Cut probe (c31's cutprobe.py, 40% front cut at t=8, exact twins) on fresh seeds 6-9 (audit_table.txt, audit_cuts.png): seed 6 loses its polarity at once (0.28 -> 0.004), retracts as a non-polar disk and is gone at t=9.0 while its twin crawls on; seed 7 loses polarity, re-nucleates it by t=11 but is not yet crawling at t=13.75 (speed 0.006); seeds 8 and 9 crawl on at 0.353 (twins 0.42). Numerical variant: seed 6 at dt/2 (WORLD_P dt 0.0005, a different noise realisation) keeps its polarity, rounds, keeps its layer and moves (alive with polarity 0.17 at t=13.75). No cut cell regains its size within the run (area 1.33-1.57 vs twins 2.60-2.63). In c31's own logs the uncut twin's cargo containment decays over the run (in/out 6.3 -> 3.4, held 0.58 -> 0.39 by t=20), so the wall slows leakage rather than sealing. My earlier review (20261026T0346-c30-review-cargo-bd) ran the matched slow-diffusion twin for W on seed 5: it loses the cargo just as the ablation does.

verdicts.limitation: Survival after a 40% front cut is stochastic: 3/4 fresh seeds (6/7 with c31's), and the dying cell is the one whose polarity collapses before it re-nucleates, so the claim's 3/3 overstates it. No cut cell regains its size. The visible parts of repair, the cell's rounding and the layer's re-closure, follow automatically from curvature flow and adsorption onto any interface; what the cell does is re-nucleate its front. I leave R out of by_construction because re-nucleation is dynamic, but a reader should weigh R as polarity repair. The cargo wall leaks steadily (held 0.58 -> 0.39 in 12 t). No S: the cell is planted.
